How the typing test works

Choose a duration, mode, and difficulty, then type the passage shown in the workbench. The timer starts on the first valid typed character, live metrics update as you type, and the final result appears when time runs out or the passage is completed.

What WPM and CPM mean

WPM means words per minute. For standard typing tests, five characters count as one word, which keeps scores comparable across different passages. CPM means characters per minute and is useful when you want a more direct view of keyboard pace.

How accuracy is calculated

Accuracy compares correct characters with everything you typed. Incorrect and extra characters count as mistakes, so clean typing improves both your accuracy and your net WPM result.

Typing practice tips
Keep your eyes on the next word instead of the keyboard.
Type at a steady pace before trying to raise your speed.
Repeat short tests to build consistency and reduce errors.
Practice punctuation and numbers separately when they slow you down.
Review mistakes after each test, then try again with a calmer rhythm.
Common typing test durations

Use 30 seconds for a quick warmup, 1 minute for a fast WPM check, 2 or 3 minutes for balanced practice, and 5 minutes when you want a steadier benchmark that rewards focus over a longer session.
